_comment: Octail curated egg (plan §6.4), written for Octail on the pattern of the Fabric and Purpur eggs (pelican-eggs' Quilt egg was only read for reference): the Quilt installer from Quilt's Maven repository with the SHA-256 Maven publishes checked (the hashes Quilt's meta service lists did not match the jars on 2026-10-12), the Mojang server jar with Mojang's SHA-1 checked, the newest stable loader for the Minecraft version or a pinned one; a version or loader that does not exist fails the install. the eula flag (the panel asks the owner on the first start, nothing is pre-accepted), Java 25 to 8 images (newest first), the install in octail-yolks installer_java_21, Minecraft Java idle sleep, install sandbox defaults and resource hints.
name: Quilt
author: octail@meowgafactory.com
description: Quilt is an open-source, community-driven mod loader for Minecraft Java, built on Fabric. Runs Quilt mods and most Fabric mods.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Quilt installation (Octail): the Quilt installer from Quilt's Maven repository, checked against the
# SHA-256 file Maven publishes next to it (Quilt's meta service lists hashes too, but on 2026-10-12 they
# didn't match the published jars, so they aren't used), the Mojang server jar checked against the SHA-1
# Mojang lists for it, then the installer's server launcher (quilt-server-launch.jar and libraries/).
# The installer fetches the loader's libraries from the Quilt and Fabric Maven repositories over HTTPS;
# it doesn't check them, and neither does this script.
# A Minecraft or loader version Quilt doesn't have fails the install instead of installing another one.
#
# Server files: /mnt/server
set -euo pipefail

META=https://meta.quiltmc.org/v3/versions
MOJANG=https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json
JAR="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
VANILLA=minecraft-server.jar
VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
LOADER="${LOADER_VERSION:-latest}"
INSTALLER="${INSTALLER_VERSION:-latest}"

fail() {
	echo "Install failed: $*"
	exit 1
}
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 "$1"; }
fetch() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 --connect-timeout 20 -o "$2" "$1"; }

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

[[ "${JAR}" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9._-]+\.jar$ ]] || fail "the jar name (${JAR}) must be a plain .jar file name"
[ "${JAR}" != "${VANILLA}" ] || fail "${VANILLA} is the Mojang server jar; pick another name for the Quilt launcher"

# Minecraft version: latest stable, the newest snapshot, or one Quilt lists.
GAMES=$(get "${META}/game") || fail "can't reach Quilt's meta service (${META})"
case "${VERSION}" in
"" | latest) VERSION=$(echo "${GAMES}" | jq -r 'map(select(.stable)) | .[0].version // empty') ;;
snapshot) VERSION=$(echo "${GAMES}" | jq -r '.[0].version // empty') ;;
esac
[ -n "${VERSION}" ] || fail "Quilt's meta service named no Minecraft version"
echo "${GAMES}" | jq -e --arg v "${VERSION}" 'any(.[]; .version == $v)' >/dev/null ||
	fail "Quilt has no Minecraft ${VERSION}. The versions are listed at ${META}/game"

# Loader: the newest stable one (no -beta) that supports this Minecraft version, or the one given.
FOR_GAME=$(get "${META}/loader/${VERSION}" | jq -c '[.[].loader.version]') ||
	fail "can't list the Quilt loaders for ${VERSION}"
if [ -z "${LOADER}" ] || [ "${LOADER}" = "latest" ]; then
	# The full list is newest first; the list per Minecraft version isn't sorted.
	ALL=$(get "${META}/loader" | jq -c '[.[].version | select(contains("-") | not)]') ||
		fail "can't list the Quilt loaders"
	LOADER=$(printf '%s\n%s\n' "${ALL}" "${FOR_GAME}" |
		jq -rs '.[1] as $ok | [.[0][] | select(. as $v | $ok | index($v))] | .[0] // empty')
	[ -n "${LOADER}" ] || fail "Quilt has no stable loader for Minecraft ${VERSION}. Set Loader Version to a beta."
fi
echo "${FOR_GAME}" | jq -e --arg l "${LOADER}" 'index($l) != null' >/dev/null ||
	fail "Quilt loader ${LOADER} doesn't support Minecraft ${VERSION}"

# Installer: the meta service lists them, Quilt's Maven repository has the jar and its SHA-256.
INSTALLERS=$(get "${META}/installer") || fail "can't list the Quilt installers"
if [ -z "${INSTALLER}" ] || [ "${INSTALLER}" = "latest" ]; then
	PICK=$(echo "${INSTALLERS}" | jq -c '.[0] // empty')
else
	PICK=$(echo "${INSTALLERS}" | jq -c --arg v "${INSTALLER}" 'map(select(.version == $v)) | .[0] // empty')
fi
[ -n "${PICK}" ] || fail "Quilt has no installer ${INSTALLER}"
INSTALLER=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.version')
URL=$(echo "${PICK}" | jq -r '.url // empty')
[[ "${URL}" =~ ^https://maven\.quiltmc\.org/ ]] || fail "Quilt's meta service named no Maven download for installer ${INSTALLER}"
SUM=$(get "${URL}.sha256" | awk '{print tolower($1)}') || fail "Quilt's Maven repository has no SHA-256 for installer ${INSTALLER}"
[[ "${SUM}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{64}$ ]] || fail "Quilt's Maven repository has no SHA-256 for installer ${INSTALLER}"
rm -f quilt-installer.jar
fetch "${URL}" quilt-installer.jar || fail "the download of the Quilt installer ${INSTALLER} failed"
GOT=$(sha256sum quilt-installer.jar | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SUM}" ]; then
	rm -f quilt-installer.jar
	fail "SHA-256 mismatch for the Quilt installer ${INSTALLER} (expected ${SUM}, got ${GOT})"
fi

# The Mojang server jar, checked against the SHA-1 Mojang lists (for the version file and the jar).
MANIFEST=$(get "${MOJANG}") || fail "can't reach Mojang's version manifest"
ENTRY=$(echo "${MANIFEST}" | jq -c --arg v "${VERSION}" '.versions | map(select(.id == $v)) | .[0] // empty')
[ -n "${ENTRY}" ] || fail "Mojang's version manifest has no Minecraft ${VERSION}"
fetch "$(echo "${ENTRY}" | jq -r '.url')" version.json.download || fail "can't download Mojang's file for ${VERSION}"
[ "$(sha1sum version.json.download | cut -d ' ' -f 1)" = "$(echo "${ENTRY}" | jq -r '.sha1')" ] ||
	fail "SHA-1 mismatch for Mojang's file for ${VERSION}"
SERVER_URL=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.url // empty' version.json.download)
SERVER_SHA1=$(jq -r '.downloads.server.sha1 // empty' version.json.download)
rm -f version.json.download
if ! [[ "${SERVER_URL}" =~ ^https:// ]] || ! [[ "${SERVER_SHA1}" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
	fail "Mojang lists no server download for ${VERSION}"
fi
fetch "${SERVER_URL}" "${VANILLA}.download" || fail "the download of the Minecraft ${VERSION} server failed"
GOT=$(sha1sum "${VANILLA}.download" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
if [ "${GOT}" != "${SERVER_SHA1}" ]; then
	rm -f "${VANILLA}.download"
	fail "SHA-1 mismatch for the Minecraft ${VERSION} server (expected ${SERVER_SHA1}, got ${GOT})"
fi
mv -f "${VANILLA}.download" "${VANILLA}"

# The launcher and its libraries, written into the server folder.
echo "Installing Quilt loader ${LOADER} for Minecraft ${VERSION} (installer ${INSTALLER})"
rm -f quilt-server-launch.jar
STATUS=0
java -jar quilt-installer.jar install server "${VERSION}" "${LOADER}" --install-dir=/mnt/server || STATUS=$?
rm -f quilt-installer.jar
[ "${STATUS}" -eq 0 ] || fail "the Quilt installer failed (see its output above)"
[ -s quilt-server-launch.jar ] || fail "the Quilt installer wrote no quilt-server-launch.jar"
if [ -f "${JAR}" ]; then
	mv -f "${JAR}" "${JAR}.old"
fi
mv quilt-server-launch.jar "${JAR}"
# The launcher starts the Mojang jar named here.
echo "serverJar=${VANILLA}" >quilt-server-launcher.properties

echo "Quilt loader ${LOADER} for Minecraft ${VERSION} installed as ${JAR} (installer SHA-256 and Mojang SHA-1 checked)."
echo "Accepting the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA) is the server owner's decision: the panel asks on the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description:
The Minecraft version to install, such as 1.21.11, latest for the newest release Quilt supports, or snapshot for the newest snapshot. A version Quilt does not list fails the install.

The Startup image must fit it: Java 25 for the newest releases, Java 21 for 1.20.5 to 1.21.x, Java 17 for 1.17 to 1.20.4, Java 8 or 11 before that.

variables.name: Loader Version
variables.description: The Quilt loader to install, such as 0.30.1, or latest for the newest stable loader that supports the Minecraft version. Betas only when named.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jar file (the Quilt launcher). The Mojang server jar next to it is minecraft-server.jar.

variables.name: Installer Version
variables.description: The Quilt installer to run, or latest.
